course.title: Microsoft Cybersecurity Architect
course.audience: Security professionals holding SC-200, SC-300 or AZ-500 who design rather than configure.
course.audienceAr: مختصو الأمن الحاصلون على إحدى الشهادات المؤهلة ممن يصممون لا يعدّون.

source.title: Study guide for Exam SC-100: Microsoft Cybersecurity Architect
source.prerequisite: An active SC-200, SC-300 or AZ-500 certification is required for the Expert credential.

domains.title: Solutions that align with security best practices and priorities
domains.titleAr: حلول متوائمة مع الممارسات الفضلى والأولويات
domains.framing: This domain is about frameworks and judgement, not products. Every question asks which approach fits a stated business situation.
domains.framingAr: هذا المجال عن الأطر والحكم لا عن المنتجات، وكل سؤال فيه يسأل أي مقاربة تناسب وضعا تجاريا موصوفا.

topics.title: Resiliency against ransomware and other attacks
topics.titleAr: المرونة أمام برمجيات الفدية وغيرها من الهجمات
teach: Prioritising threats against business critical assets rather than treating all assets alike
Business continuity and disaster recovery across hybrid and multicloud, with backup and restore that survives the attacker
Why privileged access and BCDR are prioritised together in the ransomware guidance
Evaluating how security updates are delivered and verified
topics.trap: Students reach for a backup product. The exam wants the ordering: which asset, restored in what order, protected by which privileged access boundary.
topics.trapAr: يهرع الطلبة إلى منتج نسخ احتياطي، بينما يريد الاختبار الترتيب، أي أصل يُستعاد وبأي تسلسل ومحميا بأي حد للوصول المتميز.

topics.title: MCRA and the Microsoft Cloud Security Benchmark
teach: Reading MCRA as a map of integration points rather than a poster
Best practice controls for insider, external and supply chain attacks
Aligning an AI solution to MCSB
The Zero Trust adoption framework as a sequencing tool
topics.trap: Zero Trust is no longer its own domain. It is now a lens applied inside this objective, and students who studied the older blueprint expect a third of the exam on it.
topics.trapAr: لم تعد الثقة الصفرية مجالا مستقلا بل صارت عدسة داخل هذا الهدف، ومن درس المخطط الأقدم يتوقع ثلث الاختبار عليها.

topics.title: Cloud Adoption Framework and Well-Architected Framework
topics.titleAr: إطار تبني السحابة وإطار حسن التصميم
teach: A strategy for secure AI adoption
Evaluating an existing governance strategy against CAF and WAF rather than designing from nothing
Azure landing zones as the unit of governed deployment
A DevSecOps process expressed in CAF terms
topics.trap: CAF and WAF get confused. CAF is the adoption journey, WAF is the quality of a given workload. Questions usually name one and expect the other to be excluded.
topics.trapAr: يختلط الإطاران، فالأول رحلة التبني والثاني جودة حمل بعينه، والأسئلة تسمي أحدهما وتتوقع استبعاد الآخر.

domains.title: Security operations, identity, and compliance capabilities
domains.framing: The largest domain alongside infrastructure. Identity carries the most weight inside it, and privileged access is the part most often underprepared.
domains.framingAr: هذا أكبر المجالات مع البنية التحتية، والهوية تحمل أثقل وزن داخله، والوصول المتميز هو الجزء الأقل استعدادا له عادة.

topics.title: Security operations
teach: XDR and SIEM together: what Defender XDR answers, what Sentinel answers, and why both appear
Centralised logging and auditing, including Purview Audit
Monitoring that spans hybrid and multicloud rather than one estate
SOAR, incident response workflows, threat hunting and incident management
Detection coverage measured against ATT&CK Enterprise, Mobile and ICS matrices
topics.trap: ICS and Mobile matrices are named explicitly. A course that treats ATT&CK as Enterprise only leaves a gap the exam has widened deliberately.
topics.trapAr: مصفوفتا المحمول وأنظمة التحكم الصناعي مسماتان صراحة، والمقرر الذي يعامل أتاك بوصفها مؤسسية فقط يترك ثغرة وسّعها الاختبار عن قصد.

topics.title: Identity and access management
teach: Agent identities using Entra Agent ID with conditional access
Access design across SaaS, PaaS, IaaS, on premises and multicloud
Entra ID in hybrid and multicloud shapes
External identities, B2B and decentralised identity
Modern authentication: conditional access, continuous access evaluation, risk scoring, protected actions
Validating that conditional access actually expresses the Zero Trust intent claimed for it
Hardening AD DS, and managing secrets, keys and certificates
topics.trap: Agent identity is new and unlike user or workload identity. Teach it as its own case or students will map it onto service principals and answer wrongly.
topics.trapAr: هوية الوكيل جديدة ومختلفة عن هوية المستخدم وهوية الحمل، فدرّسها حالة قائمة بذاتها وإلا أسقطها الطلبة على الهويات الخدمية وأجابوا خطأ.

topics.title: Securing privileged access
teach: The enterprise access model for assigning and delegating privileged roles
PIM, entitlement management and access reviews as governance rather than features
AD DS security and its resilience to the common attack paths
Administering cloud tenants securely across SaaS and multicloud
Cloud infrastructure entitlement management
Secure workstations for privileged access, including remote
topics.trap: The enterprise access model replaced the old tier model in Microsoft's language. Using tier vocabulary in class will not match the answer options.
topics.trapAr: حل نموذج وصول المؤسسة محل نموذج الطبقات في لغة مايكروسوفت، واستعمال مفردات الطبقات في القاعة لن يطابق خيارات الإجابة.

topics.title: Regulatory compliance
teach: Translating a compliance requirement into a specific technical control
Purview for addressing compliance obligations
Azure Policy as the enforcement and evidence surface
Validating alignment against standards and benchmarks in Defender for Cloud
topics.trap: Questions give a regulation and want a control, not a product name. Practise the translation step explicitly.
topics.trapAr: تعطي الأسئلة تنظيما وتريد ضابطا لا اسم منتج، فدرّب خطوة الترجمة صراحة.

domains.title: Security solutions for infrastructure
domains.framing: Posture management and endpoints dominate. Network security has been rewritten around Security Service Edge.
domains.framingAr: تهيمن إدارة الوضع الأمني والنقاط الطرفية على هذا المجال، وقد أعيدت كتابة أمن الشبكات حول حافة خدمة الأمن.

topics.title: Posture management across hybrid and multicloud
topics.titleAr: إدارة الوضع الأمني عبر البيئات الهجينة والمتعددة
teach: Defender for Cloud posture, including MCSB
Secure Score, and what it does and does not measure
Integrated posture across hybrid and multicloud
Choosing among the cloud workload protection plans
Azure Arc as the mechanism for reaching non Azure estate
Defender External Attack Surface Management
Security Exposure Management: attack paths, attack surface reduction, insights and initiatives
topics.trap: Secure Score, Defender for Cloud posture and Exposure Management are three different things that students merge into one. Separate them early with a worked example.
topics.trapAr: درجة الأمان ووضع ديفندر وإدارة الانكشاف ثلاثة أشياء مختلفة يدمجها الطلبة في واحد، ففرّق بينها مبكرا بمثال معمول.

topics.title: Server and client endpoints
teach: Requirements for servers across multiple platforms and operating systems
Mobile devices and clients: endpoint protection, hardening, configuration
IoT devices and embedded systems
OT and ICS through Defender for IoT
Security baselines for both server and client
Windows LAPS as an evaluation target
topics.trap: OT and ICS appear here and again in the ATT&CK objective. Worth teaching once properly and cross referencing, since Gulf students frequently work in sectors where this is the real job.
topics.trapAr: يظهر التشغيل والتحكم الصناعي هنا ومرة أخرى في هدف أتاك، ويحسن تدريسه مرة على وجهه مع الإحالة، فهو العمل الفعلي لكثير من طلبة الخليج.

topics.title: SaaS, PaaS and IaaS requirements
teach: Baselines per service model
IoT workloads and web workloads
Containers and container orchestration as separate requirements
Azure AI services security
topics.trap: Containers and orchestration are listed separately on purpose. Expect a question where the answer sits at the orchestration layer, not the image.
topics.trapAr: الحاويات والتنسيق مدرجان منفصلين عن قصد، فتوقع سؤالا تقع إجابته في طبقة التنسيق لا في الصورة.

topics.title: Network security and Security Service Edge
teach: Evaluating a network design against stated security requirements
Entra Internet Access as a secure web gateway
Entra Internet Access for Microsoft services, including cross tenant
Entra Private Access
topics.trap: This objective is now largely SSE. Courses built on older material spend the time on NSGs and firewalls and miss what is actually assessed.
topics.trapAr: صار هذا الهدف في معظمه عن حافة خدمة الأمن، والمقررات المبنية على مواد أقدم تنفق الوقت على مجموعات أمن الشبكة والجدران وتفوّت ما يُقاس فعلا.

domains.title: Security solutions for applications and data
domains.framing: Microsoft 365, application lifecycle and data protection. AI now appears on both the data and the productivity side.
domains.framingAr: مايكروسوفت ٣٦٥ ودورة حياة التطبيق وحماية البيانات، ويظهر الذكاء الاصطناعي الآن في جانبي البيانات والإنتاجية.

topics.title: Securing Microsoft 365
teach: Posture for productivity and collaboration measured by Secure Score
Defender for Office 365 and Defender for Cloud Apps
Intune for device management
Purview for securing data inside Microsoft 365
Data security and compliance controls in Copilot for Microsoft 365
topics.trap: Copilot controls are new. Students assume existing Purview labelling covers it and stop there.
topics.trapAr: ضوابط كوبايلوت جديدة، ويفترض الطلبة أن وسم بيرفيو القائم يغطيها فيتوقفون عندها.

topics.title: Securing applications
teach: Assessing the posture of an existing application portfolio
Threat modelling business critical applications
A full lifecycle application security strategy
Standards and practices for the development process itself
Mapping technologies onto application security requirements
Workload identities for authenticating to Azure resources
API management and security
Azure Web Application Firewall
topics.trap: Workload identity and agent identity are now both examinable and are not the same thing. Contrast them side by side.
topics.trapAr: هوية الحمل وهوية الوكيل كلتاهما قابلة للاختبار الآن وليستا الشيء نفسه، فقابل بينهما جنبا إلى جنب.

topics.title: Securing organisational data
teach: Data discovery and classification
Prioritising which data threats to mitigate first
Encryption at rest and in transit, Key Vault, infrastructure encryption
Security for data used in AI workloads
Azure SQL, Synapse Analytics and Cosmos DB
Azure Storage, with Defender for Storage and Defender for Databases
topics.trap: Discovery and classification come before controls. Questions that lead with an encryption option are often testing whether you classify first.
topics.trapAr: الاكتشاف والتصنيف يسبقان الضوابط، والأسئلة التي تبدأ بخيار تعمية تختبر غالبا هل تصنّف أولا.

new_in_2026.label: Agent identity
new_in_2026.why: Entra Agent ID and conditional access for non human agent identities. New surface, and the one most likely to appear in a scenario that no older course covers.

new_in_2026.label: Secure AI adoption
new_in_2026.why: A named strategy objective rather than an aside. Expect to justify an adoption approach, not describe a product.

new_in_2026.label: AI against the cloud benchmark
new_in_2026.why: Designing AI solutions that align to MCSB. Ties AI back to the benchmark students already know.

new_in_2026.label: Data in AI workloads
new_in_2026.why: Security for data consumed by AI, separate from classic data at rest and in transit.

new_in_2026.label: Copilot data controls
new_in_2026.why: Evaluating data security and compliance controls in Copilot for Microsoft 365.

new_in_2026.label: Azure AI services security
new_in_2026.why: AI services now sit inside the SaaS, PaaS and IaaS requirements objective.

new_in_2026.label: Security Exposure Management
new_in_2026.why: Attack paths, attack surface reduction and initiatives. Distinct from Secure Score and from Defender for Cloud posture.

new_in_2026.label: Security Service Edge
new_in_2026.why: Entra Internet Access and Private Access, including cross tenant. This replaced older generic network objectives.

new_in_2026.label: Purview Audit
new_in_2026.why: Named explicitly under centralised logging and auditing.

new_in_2026.label: ATT&CK beyond Enterprise
new_in_2026.why: Detection coverage assessed against Mobile and ICS matrices, not Enterprise alone.

new_in_2026.label: Windows LAPS
new_in_2026.why: Named as an evaluation target for endpoint objectives.

sessions.title: How this exam thinks
sessions.aim: Establish that every question is an architectural decision under constraints, not a configuration recall. Walk one full case study before any content.
sessions.aimAr: ترسيخ أن كل سؤال قرار معماري تحت قيود لا استرجاعا لإعداد، مع استعراض حالة كاملة قبل أي محتوى.

sessions.title: Resiliency and ransomware
sessions.aim: Prioritisation of business critical assets, then BCDR, then the privileged access link that makes restore survivable.
sessions.aimAr: ترتيب الأصول الحرجة أولا ثم استمرارية الأعمال ثم صلة الوصول المتميز التي تجعل الاستعادة قابلة للنجاة.

sessions.title: MCRA, MCSB and Zero Trust as a lens
sessions.titleAr: المعمارية المرجعية والمعيار والثقة الصفرية عدسةً
sessions.aim: Read MCRA as integration points. Place Zero Trust correctly: a lens inside this objective, not the separate domain older material describes.
sessions.aimAr: قراءة المعمارية المرجعية بوصفها نقاط تكامل، ووضع الثقة الصفرية موضعها الصحيح عدسةً داخل هذا الهدف لا مجالا مستقلا كما تصفه المواد الأقدم.

sessions.title: CAF, WAF, landing zones and DevSecOps
sessions.aim: Separate CAF from WAF with a worked example. Introduce secure AI adoption as a strategy question.
sessions.aimAr: الفصل بين الإطارين بمثال عملي، وتقديم تبني الذكاء الاصطناعي الآمن بوصفه سؤال استراتيجية.

sessions.title: SIEM, XDR and coverage
sessions.aim: What Sentinel answers versus what Defender XDR answers. Coverage assessed against Enterprise, Mobile and ICS matrices.
sessions.aimAr: ما يجيب عنه سنتينل مقابل ما يجيب عنه ديفندر، والتغطية مقاسة أمام مصفوفات المؤسسات والمحمول وأنظمة التحكم الصناعي.

sessions.title: Identity and access, including agent identity
sessions.aim: Conditional access as the expression of intent. Teach agent identity as its own case so it is not collapsed into service principals.
sessions.aimAr: الوصول المشروط تعبيرا عن النية، وتدريس هوية الوكيل حالةً قائمة بذاتها كي لا تُدمج مع الهويات الخدمية.

sessions.title: Privileged access
sessions.aim: The enterprise access model in Microsoft's current vocabulary. PIM, entitlement management and access reviews as governance.
sessions.aimAr: نموذج وصول المؤسسة بمفردات مايكروسوفت الحالية، وإدارة الهوية المتميزة والاستحقاقات ومراجعات الوصول بوصفها حوكمة.

sessions.title: Regulatory compliance
sessions.aim: Drill the translation step: a named obligation becomes a specific control, then evidence. Use a local instrument the room knows.
sessions.aimAr: تمرين خطوة الترجمة، إذ يصير الالتزام المسمى ضابطا محددا ثم دليلا، باستعمال أداة تشريعية محلية تعرفها القاعة.

sessions.title: Posture management
sessions.aim: Separate Secure Score, Defender for Cloud posture and Exposure Management with one worked estate. Attack paths and initiatives.
sessions.aimAr: الفصل بين درجة الأمان ووضع ديفندر وإدارة الانكشاف ببيئة واحدة معمولة، مع مسارات الهجوم والمبادرات.

sessions.title: Servers, clients, IoT and OT
sessions.aim: Baselines per platform, and Defender for IoT for OT and ICS. This is the session closest to the day job for much of the Gulf.
sessions.aimAr: خطوط الأساس لكل منصة، وديفندر لإنترنت الأشياء للتشغيل والتحكم الصناعي، وهذه أقرب الجلسات إلى العمل اليومي لكثير من الخليج.

sessions.title: SaaS, PaaS, IaaS, containers and AI services
sessions.titleAr: الخدمات والمنصات والحاويات وخدمات الذكاء الاصطناعي
sessions.aim: Requirements per service model. Containers and orchestration treated separately, because the exam separates them.
sessions.aimAr: المتطلبات حسب نموذج الخدمة، والحاويات والتنسيق منفصلان لأن الاختبار يفصل بينهما.

sessions.title: Network security and Security Service Edge
sessions.aim: Entra Internet Access and Private Access. Say plainly that this objective replaced the older network content students may have studied.
sessions.aimAr: الوصول عبر الإنترنت والوصول الخاص، مع التصريح بأن هذا الهدف حل محل محتوى الشبكات الأقدم الذي ربما درسه الطلبة.

sessions.title: Securing Microsoft 365 and Copilot
sessions.aim: Defender for Office 365, Defender for Cloud Apps, Intune, Purview. Copilot data controls as a distinct evaluation.
sessions.aimAr: ديفندر للأوفيس والتطبيقات السحابية وإنتيون وبيرفيو، وضوابط بيانات كوبايلوت تقييما مستقلا.

sessions.title: Application security across the lifecycle
sessions.aim: Threat modelling, lifecycle strategy, API security and WAF. Contrast workload identity against agent identity directly.
sessions.aimAr: نمذجة التهديدات واستراتيجية دورة الحياة وأمن الواجهات وجدار التطبيقات، مع مقابلة هوية الحمل بهوية الوكيل مباشرة.

sessions.title: Data security, including AI workloads
sessions.titleAr: أمن البيانات ومنه أحمال الذكاء الاصطناعي
sessions.aim: Classification before controls. Encryption, Key Vault, the Azure data platforms, and data used by AI.
sessions.aimAr: التصنيف قبل الضوابط، ثم التعمية وخزنة المفاتيح ومنصات البيانات والبيانات التي يستهلكها الذكاء الاصطناعي.

sessions.title: Case studies and exam strategy
sessions.aim: Two timed case studies. Teach the elimination method for scenario questions and the pass mark arithmetic.
sessions.aimAr: دراستا حالة موقوتتان، وتدريس أسلوب الاستبعاد لأسئلة السيناريو وحساب درجة النجاح.
